Subject: Order Form commercial redlines — pricing cadence, VAT handling & PO routing

Hi Alice / Ben,

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Attached is the redline of the Order Form reflecting the commercial cadence we discussed. Two items I want to make sure we lock before legal final review:

- Minimum commit phasing: we propose a three-tranche schedule (Q1 40%, Q2 30%, Q3 30%) with invoice triggers tied to activation dates; see Pricing Appendix B.
- VAT / withholding: for EU entities we mark Redwood as the invoice issuer and the customer is responsible for local VAT unless a reverse-charge applies — we need confirmation from your tax team.
- PO routing & invoice recipient: customers often ask invoices to route to a central AP inbox (finance@acme-corp.com) but the contract lists the legal entity and billing contact. We should confirm if a generic PO number is acceptable for Net 45 processing or if separate entity invoices are required.

I've included inline comments where Finance asked for a sample invoice flow and where Legal had open redline markers. Please take a look and let me know whether your team can accept the proposed VAT language and invoice entity flow. If you prefer, we can push draft DocuSign for signature once redlines are resolved.

Attachments: ACME_OrderForm_20260802_redline.pdf (redline), OF-pricing-diff-annotations.docx (diff notes)

Next steps: can you confirm by EOD Wed (Aug 4) whether Finance needs entity-level invoices or if central AP routing is fine? If Ben needs Legal time, please indicate earliest availability.

Thanks,

—
Marissa Cole

From: Alice Nguyen <finance@acme-corp.com>

Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2026 08:34:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Order Form commercial redlines — pricing cadence, VAT handling & PO routing

Marissa — thanks for the redline and summary.

A few clarifications from Acme Finance:
1) For VAT we need the contract to state whether Redwood will issue VAT invoices from a UK/EU entity or whether reverse charge will apply. If Redwood invoices from the US, Acme will self-account via reverse charge where applicable, but we need the legal language to be explicit.
2) Invoice routing: central AP (finance@acme-corp.com) is fine provided invoices reference the operating entity on the invoice (legal entity name + VAT ID). We cannot process invoices that do not show the entity.
3) Net terms: our standard is Net 45 for annual contracts; Net 30 for short-term pilots. We can accept Net 45 here.

Ben — can Legal confirm the VAT clause language and whether the proposed invoice wording in Appendix B is sufficient for entity-level detail?

Thanks,
Alice

Looping in Kimberly from Legal to validate contract wording. My suggested commercial posture below to keep procurement moving:

- Accept Net 45 as Acme's preference. We propose Net 45 on cleared invoices and standard late fee language per our MSA.
- VAT language (recommended): "Invoices will be issued by Redwood Inference US, Inc. For EU VAT-liable purchases, Acme shall apply the reverse-charge mechanism where applicable; Redwood will cooperate to provide VAT ID and invoicing details on request." (this keeps Redwood from having to register unless requested).
- Invoice content: require invoice to include (1) legal entity name, (2) VAT/Tax ID if applicable, (3) PO number if provided. That satisfies Acme Finance while allowing central AP routing.

I've attached a short diff with the exact clause edits (OF-pricing-diff-annotations.docx). If Kimberly is comfortable, can Legal sign off and we push DocuSign (link below) so Acme can route internally?

Hi all — thanks for the clear notes. Legal has reviewed Karthik's proposed wording and the redline. A few small cleanups but nothing substantive.

- We will keep Redwood invoicing from Redwood Inference US, Inc. by default. Clause will include the reverse-charge sentence so Acme can self-account. If Acme requires Redwood to invoice from an EU entity, we'll include a path to register and amend the Order Form (standard addendum).
- Invoice requirements: added explicit line that invoice must include the billed legal entity and VAT/Tax ID (if applicable). This will be a condition of payment processing.
- Net terms: Net 45 accepted. We will not push for earlier terms given the customer preference.

Ben — feel free to countersign on behalf of Acme when you confirm token wording below; otherwise, Marissa / Alice, if you confirm DocuSign flow we will prepare final redline and upload to DocuSign: https://docusign.com/remoteSigning/abcd-1234-acme-orderform
